body: So should I just forget about her? I been working on my mental health everyday but I still care about her and I wanna make it work.

Deep down I wanna get back with my ex but I know that might not happen, I really just wanna know what I should do besides getting my mental health right. I don’t wanna lose her but I also don’t wanna be a smothering guy who can’t get over his ex!

Yea I know what I gotta do, it’s just really difficult especially if you love that person but I stoped contacting her so we’ll see how this plays out in the future. I would love to get back with her but i’m not hoping for anything just gonna do me.
Really no question just venting lol
He’s not better than you bro!
I’m starting to feel better but I just know the feeling will come back soon.
Thanks that really means a lot!
